pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Teleports the creature you are looking at to you.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() Path level 3.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: The target must be valid and within range. The default range is $(thing)48 blocks$(), controlled by $(thing)summonRange$(). Other players cannot be summoned.
